operations.name: Accept a dispute
operations.description: Accept a dispute, acknowledging it as lost. This is irreversible — the dispute status changes to 'lost' and the disputed amount is deducted from your balance. Only accept if you do not wish to contest.

operations.name: Activate or deactivate a fund account
operations.description: Activate or deactivate a fund account. Fund account details are immutable — only the `active` status can be changed.

fund_account_id.description: Unique identifier of the fund account (e.g. `fa_00000000000001`).

operations.name: Add an allowed payer (tpv)
operations.description: Whitelist a specific payer bank account or VPA for a virtual account (Smart Collect with Third Party Validation). Only whitelisted payers can successfully pay into this virtual account.

operations.name: Add a vpa receiver to a virtual account
operations.description: Add a UPI VPA receiver to an existing virtual account (Smart Collect 2.0). Requires the VPA receiver feature to be enabled on the merchant account.

operations.name: Approve a payout (workflow enabled)
operations.description: Requires Payouts Approval workflow enabled and Technology Partner status with OAuth.

payout_id.description: Unique identifier of the payout to approve.

operations.name: Cancel an invoice
operations.description: Cancel a draft or issued invoice. Cancelled invoices cannot be paid and cannot be reinstated.

operations.name: Cancel a payment link
operations.description: Cancel a payment link. Only links in 'created' status can be cancelled. Paid, partially paid, and already expired links cannot be cancelled.

operations.name: Cancel a queued payout
operations.description: Only payouts in 'queued' status can be cancelled.

payout_id.description: Unique identifier of the payout to cancel.

operations.name: Cancel a payout link
operations.description: Cancel a payout link that is in `issued` or `pending` state.

payout_link_id.description: Unique identifier of the payout link to cancel.

operations.name: Cancel a subscription
operations.description: Cancel an active or authenticated subscription. Use cancel_at_cycle_end=1 to continue service until the end of the current cycle before cancelling.

cancel_at_cycle_end.description: 1 = cancel at end of current cycle; 0 = cancel immediately.

operations.name: Cancel scheduled changes
operations.description: Cancel any pending plan or quantity changes that were scheduled for the next billing cycle.

operations.name: Capture a payment
operations.description: Capture an authorized payment to collect funds. Must be called within the capture window (default 5 days). Amount must exactly equal authorized amount unless partial capture is enabled.

id.description: Payment ID (pay_*). Must be in 'authorized' status.

amount.description: Amount to capture in paise. Must equal authorized amount unless partial capture is enabled.

operations.name: Close a qr code
operations.description: Deactivate a QR code to stop accepting new payments. Once closed, the QR code cannot be reopened.

operations.name: Close a virtual account
operations.description: Manually close an active virtual account so it no longer accepts payments.

status.description: Must be 'closed' to close the account.

operations.name: Contest a dispute
operations.description: Submit evidence to challenge a dispute. Use action=draft to save without submitting, or action=submit to send for bank review (triggers payment.dispute.under_review webhook). At least one evidence document is required when submitting. You can contest partial amounts by specifying amount.

action.description: draft: save evidence without submitting. submit: send for bank review. Minimum one document required for submit.

amount.description: Amount being contested (paise). Defaults to full dispute amount.

summary.description: Your explanation of why the dispute should be resolved in your favour. Max 1000 characters.

operations.name: Create a bill
operations.description: Create a digital bill/receipt for a customer. Supports retail, food & beverage, events, and ecommerce use cases. Used for Razorpay Billme digital receipts.

operations.name: Create a contact
operations.description: Create a payout recipient contact. Returns existing contact if all identifying fields (name, email, contact, type) match an existing record.

operations.name: Create a customer
operations.description: Create a customer profile. The combination of email and contact must be unique per customer. Customer profiles enable saved card tokens, faster checkout, and customer-scoped data.

name.description: Customer name. 3-50 characters. Allowed: alphanumeric, period, apostrophe, forward slash, @, parentheses.

contact.description: Phone number with country code. Min 8 digits, max 15 chars. Example: +919876543210.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a direct transfer
operations.description: Create an on-demand direct transfer from the merchant account to a Linked Account. Requires the Direct Transfer feature to be enabled on the account. Supports idempotency via the X-Transfer-Idempotency header (unique to direct transfers).

X-Transfer-Idempotency.description: Idempotency key for direct transfers. If provided, retrying with the same key within 24 hours returns the original transfer instead of creating a duplicate.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a fund account
operations.description: Create a bank account, VPA, card, or wallet (Amazon Pay) fund account linked to a contact. Fund accounts are immutable after creation. Returns existing record if contact_id + account details all match.

operations.name: Create an instant settlement
operations.description: Request an on-demand (instant) settlement of your available Razorpay balance to your bank account. Fees apply. Use settle_full_balance=true to settle everything available, or specify an amount.

settle_full_balance.description: Set true to settle the full available balance. Overrides amount.

description.description: Custom reference note. Max 30 alphanumeric characters.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create an invoice
operations.description: Create an invoice or payment page. Set type='invoice' for a formal invoice or type='link' for a simple payment page. The invoice is created in draft state; call POST /invoices/{id}/issue to send it to the customer. Cannot be used to create GST invoices (use the Dashboard for those). Maximum 50 line items per invoice.

type.description: invoice: formal invoice; link: payment page.

customer_id.description: Existing customer ID (cust_*). Provide this OR customer object, not both.

customer.description: Inline customer details. Used when no customer_id is available.

line_items.description: Invoice line items. Each item must have name and amount (in paise), or an item_id to reference a catalog item.

terms.description: Payment terms shown on the invoice.

partial_payment.description: Allow customer to pay a partial amount initially.

first_payment_min_amount.description: Minimum first payment amount in paise. Required when partial_payment=true.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the invoice expires. Must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create an item
operations.description: Create a reusable catalog item. Items can be referenced in invoice line_items by item_id, which auto-fills price and description. Each item is merchant-scoped.

operations.name: Create a linked account
operations.description: Create a sub-merchant (Linked Account) under a Route marketplace. The account type must be 'route'. Email and business_type cannot be changed after creation. Only one stakeholder is allowed per Linked Account.

email.description: Contact email. Cannot be changed after creation.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create an order
operations.description: Create an order before initiating a payment. The returned order_id must be passed to Razorpay Checkout. An order can have multiple payment attempts but only one successful capture.

amount.description: Payment amount in paise. Example: 50000 for ₹500. Must be >= 100.

receipt.description: Your internal receipt number. Max 40 characters.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a webhook for a sub merchant
operations.description: Create a webhook to receive events for a sub-merchant account. Maximum 30 webhooks per account. Authentication: OAuth access_token.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the linked merchant account (e.g. `acc_00000000000001`).

operations.name: Create a payment link
operations.description: Create a shareable payment link to collect payments via SMS and email. Supports standard links (all payment methods) and UPI-only links (set upi_link=true). UPI links are not available in test mode. Partial payments are not supported for UPI links. Links expire after 6 months by default.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (paise for INR). Example: 50000 for ₹500.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. UPI links support INR only.

upi_link.description: Set true to create a UPI-only Payment Link. Not available in test mode.

accept_partial.description: Enable partial payments. Not supported for UPI links.

first_min_partial_amount.description: Minimum first partial payment amount in paise.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp for link expiry. Max 6 months from creation. Must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

reference_id.description: Your unique tracking reference. Max 40 characters. Must be unique.

description.description: Brief description shown on the payment page. Max 2048 characters.

customer.description: Customer contact details. Not auto-populated on checkout — customer must enter manually.

notify.description: Notification handlers. Set true for Razorpay to send, false to handle yourself.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a payout
operations.description: Disburse funds via NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, or card. Supports standard payouts (fund_account_id), composite payouts (contact + fund account inline), card payouts (PCI DSS required), and mobile number payouts (resolved via NPCI mapper). Idempotency header X-Payout-Idempotency (UUID v4, 4–36 chars) is mandatory since March 15, 2025. Never generate a new idempotency key while a payout is in 'processing

X-Payout-Idempotency.description: UUID v4 idempotency key. Mandatory since March 15, 2025.

account_number.description: Razorpay X account number to debit

fund_account_id.description: Required for standard payouts; omit for composite

fund_account.description: Inline fund account for composite payout

queue_if_low_balance.description: true: queue payout when account balance is insufficient (default: false)

operations.name: Create a payout link
operations.description: Send a payout link to a contact when fund account details are unavailable. expire_by must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp; must be ≥15 minutes from now

operations.name: Create a plan
operations.description: Define a recurring billing plan with a fixed period, interval, and amount. Plans are reusable across multiple subscriptions. Once created, plan details cannot be modified.

period.description: Billing frequency unit. For daily, minimum interval is 7.

interval.description: Number of periods between charges (e.g. interval=3, period=monthly → charge every 3 months).

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a qr code
operations.description: Create a UPI QR code for accepting digital payments. Only upi_qr type is supported (on-demand feature; requires merchant activation). single_use QR codes require fixed_amount=true and close_by maximum is 45 days. multiple_use QR codes have no expiry restriction.

type.description: QR code type. Only upi_qr is supported (on-demand feature requiring merchant activation).

usage.description: single_use: auto-closes after first successful payment (requires fixed_amount=true). multiple_use: stays open for multiple payments.

fixed_amount.description: true: fixed amount QR (required for single_use). false: customer enters amount at scan time.

payment_amount.description: Fixed payment amount in paise. Required when fixed_amount=true.

customer_id.description: Associate QR code with a customer (cust_*).

close_by.description: Unix timestamp for auto-close. Maximum 45 days from creation for single_use.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a refund
operations.description: Initiate a full or partial refund for a captured payment. Use speed=normal (default, 5-7 business days) or speed=optimum for instant refund (falls back to normal if unavailable). Use the X-Refund-Idempotency header with a unique key (>=10 chars) to safely retry without duplicate refunds.

id.description: Payment ID to refund (pay_*). Payment must be captured.

amount.description: Refund amount in paise. Omit to refund the full payment amount.

speed.description: normal: 5-7 business days. optimum: instant if available, falls back to normal.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a stakeholder
operations.description: Add a business owner or director to a Linked Account. Only one stakeholder is allowed per Route Linked Account. PAN 4th character must be 'P' (individual PAN).

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the linked merchant account (e.g. `acc_00000000000001`).

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create a subscription
operations.description: Subscribe a customer to a plan. Returns a short_url that the customer MUST open to authorize the payment mandate (UPI Autopay, NACH, or card-on-file). The subscription will not charge until the mandate is authorized. Set notify_info to send the auth link via SMS/email automatically. Requires Subscriptions feature enabled on your Razorpay account.

plan_id.description: Plan ID (plan_*) to subscribe the customer to.

total_count.description: Total number of billing cycles. Use 0 for indefinite (no fixed end).

quantity.description: Number of plan units billed per cycle.

customer_notify.description: 1 to have Razorpay notify customer via SMS/email on each charge event.

start_at.description: Unix timestamp for the first charge. Defaults to subscription creation time.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the customer to authorize the mandate.

addons.description: One-time charges added to the first billing cycle only.

offer_id.description: Offer/coupon ID to apply to the subscription.

notify_info.description: If provided, Razorpay sends the mandate auth link directly to the customer.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Create transfers from a payment
operations.description: Split a captured payment to one or more Linked Accounts. Amount is deducted from the payment and transferred to the recipient. INR only, minimum ₹100 per transfer.

operations.name: Create a virtual account
operations.description: Create a virtual bank account (and optionally a VPA) for accepting NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI payments. Set amount_expected=0 to accept any amount. Auto-closes after 90 days of inactivity. Maximum close_by timestamp: 2147483647.

amount.description: Expected amount in paise. Set to 0 to accept any amount.

close_by.description: Unix timestamp to auto-close the account. Maximum: 2147483647.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.description: List payouts for a given RazorpayX account. Filter by contact, fund account, date range, or status.

account_number.description: The RazorpayX account number (Customer Identifier from Dashboard → My Account & Settings → Banking). Required to scope results to a specific account.

contact_id.description: Filter payouts by the contact ID of the recipient.

fund_account_id.description: Filter payouts by fund account ID.

from.description: Unix timestamp. Only payouts created from this timestamp onwards are returned.

to.description: Unix timestamp. Only payouts created before this timestamp are returned.

count.description: Number of payouts to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

skip.description: Number of payouts to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

operations.name: List all plans
operations.description: Retrieve all billing plans. Supports pagination.

count.description: Number of records to return per call. Maximum 100. Default 10.

skip.description: Number of records to skip. Use with count for pagination. Default 0.

operations.name: List reversals for a transfer
operations.description: Retrieve all reversals for a specific transfer.

operations.name: List all subscriptions
operations.description: Retrieve all subscriptions. Filter by plan_id or status. Returns up to 100 per call.

from.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Fetch records created on or after this time.

to.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Fetch records created on or before this time.

count.description: Number of records to return per call. Maximum 100. Default 10.

skip.description: Number of records to skip. Use with count for pagination. Default 0.

operations.name: List transactions for a razorpay x account
operations.description: Returns all transaction records (credits and debits) for a given RazorpayX account. Use account_number from Dashboard → My Account & Settings → Banking → Customer Identifier.

account_number.description: RazorpayX account number (Customer Identifier from Dashboard). Different for Test and Live mode.

count.description: Number of transactions to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

skip.description: Number of transactions to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

operations.name: List transfers
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of transfers. Filter by recipient_settlement_id to fetch transfers included in a specific settlement. Use expand[]=recipient_settlement to include settlement details.

count.description: Number of records to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

skip.description: Number of records to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

recipient_settlement_id.description: Filter transfers by settlement ID in the Linked Account.

expand[].description: Expand recipient_settlement to include full settlement object.

operations.name: List virtual accounts
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of virtual accounts with optional filters.

count.description: Number of records to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

skip.description: Number of records to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

operations.name: Modify settlement hold on a transfer
operations.description: Put a transfer's settlement on hold or release an existing hold. Use on_hold=true to hold settlement, on_hold=false to release. on_hold_until sets a future timestamp for automatic hold release.

on_hold.description: true to hold settlement; false to release.

on_hold_until.description: Unix timestamp for automatic hold release. null = hold indefinitely until manually released.

operations.name: Pause a subscription
operations.description: Pause an active subscription. No charges will be attempted while paused. Resume with POST /subscriptions/{id}/resume.

pause_at.description: When to pause. 'now' = immediately; 'cycle_end' = after current cycle.

operations.name: Reject a payout (workflow enabled)
operations.description: Requires Payouts Approval workflow enabled and Technology Partner status with OAuth.

payout_id.description: Unique identifier of the payout to reject.

operations.name: Request route product configuration
operations.description: Request activation of the Route product for a Linked Account. Submits the account for review and KYC. Activation progresses: requested → under_review → activated.

tnc_accepted.description: Set to true to accept Razorpay TnC on behalf of the sub-merchant.

operations.name: Send or resend payment link notification
operations.description: Send or resend a payment link notification to the customer via SMS or email.

operations.name: Resume a paused subscription
operations.description: Resume a paused subscription. Charging resumes on the next scheduled cycle.

resume_at.description: When to resume. Currently only 'now' is supported.

operations.name: Reverse a transfer
operations.description: Move funds from a Linked Account back to the merchant. Partial reversals are supported. Multiple reversals per transfer are allowed as long as the total reversed amount does not exceed the transfer amount.

amount.description: Amount to reverse in paise. Omit to reverse the full remaining amount.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Send invoice notification
operations.description: Send or resend the invoice payment link to the customer via SMS or email.

operations.name: Update a bill
operations.description: Update an existing digital bill. Can update customer details, line items, receipt summary, and other fields.

event.description: Event details for events business type

irn.description: Invoice Reference Number for GST e-invoicing

operations.name: Update or activate deactivate a contact
operations.description: Update contact details or activate/deactivate a contact. Set `active: false` to deactivate.

operations.name: Update a customer
operations.description: Update a customer's name, email, or contact. The combination of email and contact must remain unique. Contact number must contain at least 8 digits.

contact.description: Updated phone number. Min 8 digits including country code.

operations.name: Update an invoice
operations.description: Update invoice fields. Updatable fields depend on current status: draft=all fields; issued=partial_payment, receipt, comment, terms, notes, expire_by; paid/cancelled/expired=notes only.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

line_items.description: Replaces existing line items. Draft status only.

operations.name: Update an item
operations.description: Update the name, description, amount, currency, or active status of an item.

operations.name: Update a linked account
operations.description: Update mutable fields of a Linked Account. email and business_type cannot be changed after creation.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update an order
operations.description: Update the notes field of an existing order. Only notes can be modified after creation.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update a webhook
operations.description: Update webhook URL, events, secret, or active status for a sub-merchant account. Authentication: OAuth access_token.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the linked merchant account (e.g. `acc_00000000000001`).

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook events

events.description: Map of event names to boolean

operations.name: Update a payment
operations.description: Update the notes field of a payment. Only notes can be modified.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update a payment link
operations.description: Update an existing payment link. Updates are only allowed when the link is in 'created' or 'partially_paid' status.

reference_id.description: Add or update unique reference number. Max 40 characters.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update product configuration
operations.description: Update settlement details or other configuration for a Route product on a Linked Account.

operations.name: Update a qr code
operations.description: Update the notes field of a QR code. Only notes can be modified after creation.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update a refund
operations.description: Update the notes field of a refund. Only notes can be modified.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update a stakeholder
operations.description: Update stakeholder information for a Linked Account.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update a subscription
operations.description: Update plan, quantity, or schedule future changes for a subscription. Use schedule_change_at='now' for immediate effect (creates a new billing cycle) or 'cycle_end' to defer until the current cycle ends. Cannot change plan mid-cycle without creating a new cycle.

plan_id.description: New plan ID to switch to.

schedule_change_at.description: When changes take effect. 'now' starts a new cycle immediately; 'cycle_end' defers to end of current cycle.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

operations.name: Update a virtual account
operations.description: Update the amount_expected or close_by timestamp on an active virtual account.

operations.name: Upload kyc documents for a sub merchant account
operations.description: Upload KYC documents for business identity and address verification. Multipart form upload. JPG/PNG max 4MB, PDF max 2MB. Authentication: OAuth access_token.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the linked merchant account (e.g. `acc_00000000000001`).

operations.name: Upload a document
operations.description: Upload a file to Razorpay. Returns a document ID that can be used in dispute evidence submissions. Supports JPEG, PNG, and PDF formats.

file.description: File to upload. Supported: JPEG, PNG, PDF.

operations.name: Upload kyc documents for a stakeholder
operations.description: Upload identity and address verification documents for a stakeholder. Supports PAN, Aadhaar (front/back), passport (front/back), voter ID (front/back). Multipart form upload. JPG/PNG max 4MB, PDF max 2MB. Authentication: OAuth access_token.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the linked merchant account (e.g. `acc_00000000000001`).

operations.name: Validate a bank account or vpa
operations.description: Three validation methods: (1) penny drop for bank accounts — sends Re.1 to verify; (2) penny drop for VPA — sends Re.1 to UPI address; (3) reverse penny drop — sends UPI intent URL to customer who initiates payment. Live-mode only, RazorpayX Lite account required. Composite validation (creates Contact + Fund Account inline) supported via validation_type field.

fund_account.description: For composite validation, include contact object instead of contact_id

validation_type.description: penniless = reverse penny drop (UPI intent); optimized = system chooses best method
